description: Set Anchored Object Options on anchored items (Object > Anchored Object > Options), rotate and scale them within their anchor settings, or release them so they no longer move with the text (Object > Anchored Object > Release)

options.description: Anchored Object Options (Object > Anchored Object > Options)

anchorPoint.description: Anchored Object reference point on the object (custom)

horizontalReferencePoint.description: What the object is positioned against horizontally (custom)

spaceAbove.description: Space Before of an above-line object (mm)

verticalReferencePoint.description: What the object is positioned against vertically (custom)

yOffset.description: Y offset (mm); for inline objects, the shift from the baseline

release.description: Release the anchored objects (after any options and transform)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_anchored_object_options
title: Set Anchored Object Options
